user.title: Find your property
user.description: Enter a postcode in Rhondda Cynon Taf. Collection dates are looked up on the council's website. This integration is unofficial and not affiliated with RCT Council.

data.manual_uprn: Enter a UPRN instead of choosing from the address list

data_description.postcode: For example CF37 1AB. Spaces and capital letters are optional.
data_description.property_name: A friendly name such as Home or Mum's house. Used to name the device and entities.
data_description.manual_uprn: Only needed if your address is missing from the council's list.

reconfigure.title: Change property
reconfigure.description: Enter the postcode of the property this entry should follow. Existing entities and their history are kept.

data.manual_uprn: Enter a UPRN instead of choosing from the address list

data_description.postcode: For example CF37 1AB. Spaces and capital letters are optional.
data_description.manual_uprn: Only needed if your address is missing from the council's list.

select_address.title: Choose your address
select_address.description: The council lists {count} properties for {postcode}. Choose yours.

manual_uprn.title: Enter UPRN
manual_uprn.description: Enter the Unique Property Reference Number (UPRN) for the property at {postcode}. It appears on some council documents and on public UPRN lookup services. The schedule is only accepted if the council confirms the property is at {postcode}.

error.invalid_postcode: That doesn't look like a UK postcode.
error.invalid_uprn: A UPRN is a number of up to 12 digits.
error.postcode_not_found: The council found no addresses for this postcode. Check it is a Rhondda Cynon Taf postcode.
error.property_not_found: The council does not recognise this property.
error.property_mismatch: The council's record for this UPRN is not at the postcode you entered.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the council website. Try again later.
error.rate_limited: The council website asked us to slow down. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.parse_error: The council website returned a page this integration could not read. The website may have changed; please report it.
error.unsupported_response: The council website returned an unexpected response. Try again later.
error.no_collections: The council has not published any collections for this property.
error.no_future_collections: The council has not published any upcoming collections for this property.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This property is already set up.

data_description.update_interval: Date-based entities still update at midnight regardless of this setting.
data_description.reminder_days: The "collection due soon" sensor turns on when a collection is this many days away or fewer. 0 means today only.
data_description.included_categories: Hidden types are removed from sensors, reminders and the calendar.

service_unavailable.message: Could not reach the council website.

rate_limited.message: The council website asked us to slow down.

unsupported_response.message: The council website returned an unexpected response.

parse_error.message: The council website returned a page that could not be read. The website may have changed.

postcode_not_found.message: The council found no addresses for this postcode.

property_not_found.message: The council no longer recognises this property.

property_mismatch.message: The council returned collection dates for a different property. Reconfigure the entry to choose the correct address.

unknown_error.message: Unexpected error while fetching collection dates.
